tools.name: get_code_examples
tools.description: Return fenced code examples from the docs with parsed metadata such as title, framework, packageManager, and runnable.

tools.name: get_config_schema
tools.description: Return structured docs.config.ts option metadata, optionally filtered by option path or query.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Build deterministic, section-level documentation context for a query within a conservative UTF-8 byte ceiling derived from the requested token budget, with source URLs and accounting metadata.

tools.name: get_navigation
tools.description: Return the documentation navigation tree for the current docs site.

tools.name: hydrate_content_changes
tools.description: Fetch only added and changed agent-facing sections after list_content_changes. Returns deletion tombstones and digest-bound continuation cursors under a conservative token budget.

tools.name: list_content_changes
tools.description: Synchronize body-free document metadata. Save indexGeneration and pass it as since on the next poll. A reset response means the named snapshot is no longer available.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List documentation pages grouped by section, optionally narrowed to one section.

tools.name: list_page_sections
tools.description: Discover a page's canonical headings, anchors, hierarchy, line ranges, size estimates, and budget-aware fetch URLs without returning the page body.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the known documentation pages with titles, slugs, and URLs.

tools.name: list_search_facets
tools.description: List valid framework, version, package, and tag filters with matching page counts before calling search_docs. Use facet, limit, and cursor to continue a large facet without document bodies.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_search_facets" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List valid framework, version, package, and tag filters with matching page counts before calling search_docs. Use facet, limit, and cursor to continue a large f…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
